p: It is stated in the holy Zohar
"Whoever is of the stock and root of Yisrael
sits under the shade of faith."
that Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
was the first of the converts (Chagigah 3a),
כְּאָמְרָם זַ״ל (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ה, טז, א):
And nevertheless he is called a native,
That is because it was made clear afterward,
until Hashem, blessed be He, testified about him
that the root of his birth was in holiness,
"Yours is the dew of your youth" —
the Holy One, blessed be He, said:
And this is the matter mentioned in the Midrash
'And the dwelling of Bnei Yisrael,' etc."
And certainly the intent is not
that the calculation of the years
rather, it refers to this matter,
that the root of one's birth is in holiness;
not from the side of a person's comprehension
but from the side of connection to the root
And this is what is mentioned in the holy Zohar
above the aspect of the Name Havayah,
that is, from the aspect of Atika;
and there is the aspect of his connection
Therefore the Shabbos meal of Atika Kadisha
הוּא נֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
corresponds to Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
as is known from the holy Zohar
this is the meal of Atika Kadisha."
וְהִנֵּה עַל זֶה נֶאֱמַר (בְּרֵאשִׁית כא, ח):
on the day Yitzchak was weaned";
and it is stated in Tosafos
(שַׁבָּת קל, א, דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל שָׂשׂ אָנֹכִי):
that is, on the day Yitzchak was circumcised at eight days.
For he was the first soul
to be circumcised at eight days,
meaning that his root was in holiness
and from him holiness descended to his offspring,
that they be "borne from the womb";
and they are called "Your people are all tzaddikim,"
because "from the womb they are circumcised for Your Name";
that is, holiness is rooted in them
"For through Yitzchak shall offspring be called yours";
And for this Avraham then made
a great feast "on the day of hi-gamel,"
for then it became clear to him
that about him too Hashem, blessed be He, testified
that the root of his birth too is in holiness,
since he begot such holy offspring,
from whom the holy seed would descend for generations,
who would be bound by their birth
And to this the Midrash alludes
"The Great One of the worlds was there";
that is, the root shone forth
which is the aspect of Arich Anpin;
And from this the joy in his heart grew,
since there was made known to him
and so he had no need to fear
And along these lines we heard
in the name of the Baal Shem Tov, of blessed memory,
that if he knew for certain about himself
that he is of the seed of Avraham, Yitzchak and Yaakov —
that is, that in the root of his birth
he is bound up with holiness —
he would walk with his hat
כַּנָּהוּג מִי שֶׁהוּא שָׂשׂ וְשָׂמֵחַ בְּעַצְמוֹ
as is the way of one who is glad and joyful in himself
because he goes his way securely
from our holy Rebbe, of blessed memory,
שֶׁעִם כָּל זֶה יוּכַל לִפְעוֹל זֹאת
that even so, one can bring this about
that he be considered as being, from the root of his birth,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁמָּצִינוּ בְּדָוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם,
is as we find with Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him,
whom they wanted to disqualify from the congregation
עַל פִּי דִּין וּסְבָרָא שֶׁל הַתּוֹרָה,
according to the law and reasoning of the Torah,
and only through mercy did he bring it about
on the basis of received tradition:
"a Moabite man, but not a Moabite woman."
And it is like what we said
regarding Avraham Avinu, peace be upon him,
that his meriting to be called Yisrael
as is stated in the holy Zohar
"Your fathers dwelt beyond the River of old":
"For from a distant place He brought him near,
כְּמָה דְּאַתְּ אָמַר: וָאֶקַּח אֶת אֲבִיכֶם;
as it says, 'And I took your father'";
that is, through an arousal from Above,
from the aspect of Heaven's mercy.
And let us return to the matter:
to this the holy Zohar alludes:
"Whoever is of the stock and root of Yisrael" —
that is, one who is confident about himself
that the root of his birth is in holiness —
he "sits in the shade of faith"
and take shelter in Him, blessed be He, with his emunah
because he has a connection to the root;
וְלָכֵן אֵין לוֹ לִפְחוֹד מִשּׁוּם רָע,
and therefore he has no need to fear any evil,
Now the people of Yisrael as a whole
that is, they are bound by their birth to the root,
in the inwardness of the point of their heart,
"It is revealed and known before You
that our will is to do Your will;
only the leaven in the dough holds us back."
וְזֶה נִתְגַּלָּה עַל יְדֵי מִצְוַת סוּכָּה,
And this is revealed through the mitzvah of sukkah,
so that through it we have
and from this joy is drawn to us
which is "the time of our rejoicing,"
עַל פָּסוּק: וַיַּעַשׂ אַבְרָהָם מִשְׁתֶּה גָּדוֹל:
on the verse "And Avraham made a great feast."
